title: [CUDA][cuDNN][2.9] CUDA 12.8 wheels ship with cuDNN 9.10.2 but CI is installing 9.8.0
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

@drisspg noticed that cuDNN wasn't being selected as the default backend for SDPA where expected.
This seem to be because the wheel build checks cuDNN version at compile time (9.8) which is too old for the minimum on by default setting (9.9).

CI install:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/e50dc40d28ba409930023c77a031ec0dd20fd73b/.ci/docker/common/install_cuda.sh#L132

Binary build matrix:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/9315f44cd64d6e25abc30e8db35fb0e4d6141eb6/.github/scripts/generate_binary_build_matrix.py#L67

Meanwhile the wheels are shipping with cuDNN 9.10.2 which should support cuDNN-on-by-default for SDPA.

### Versions

`release/2.9`

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @seemethere @malfet @atalman @csarofeen @ptrblck @xwang233 @jerryzh168
